run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the k-th prime factor of a given number n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that finds the k-th prime factor of a number

review_f_gold: review f_gold for correctness when n is a prime number larger than 2
